notes: Defect: promo code/discount amount is not displayed correctly for return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. The map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch mapper passes discount.amount through directly, but the create-reservations mapper already swaps from/to stations for return trips (lines 57-74) — suggesting return trips need special handling that may not be applied consistently to the discount/promo amount. The apply-report-discounts service and return-trip-modification mapper are likely involved in how the discount is computed or propagated for return trips.

notes: Openspec provided no acceptance criteria (empty array) and only a technical investigation note. I created all 8 ACs from scratch based on the defect description and the referenced files. AC-1 is the core fix verification. AC-2 ensures no regression on one-way trips. AC-3 targets the specific mapper interaction where from/to station swapping may affect discount propagation. AC-4 and AC-5 cover edge cases (no discount, zero discount). AC-6 covers the case where outbound and return legs have different discounts. AC-7 and AC-8 trace the discount through the apply-report-discounts service and return-trip-modification mapper respectively, ensuring consistency end-to-end.
